product.name: قرض وطني (National Loan)
product.description: A loan designed for starting or developing small home-based projects, or for low-income families for various needs such as medical treatment, home improvement, or purchasing durable goods.

product.name: قرض مشروعي (My Project Loan)
product.description: A loan for starting or developing small home-based projects, available in different categories based on the loan amount and repayment period.

product.name: قرض صديق البيئة (Eco-Friendly Loan)
product.description: A loan for purchasing energy-saving home appliances, targeting existing and potential customers interested in eco-friendly solutions.

product.name: قرض الخلايا الشمسية (Solar Panel Loan)
product.description: A loan for installing solar energy systems, aimed at promoting renewable energy and reducing energy consumption.

product.name: قرض بذار (Seed Loan)
product.description: A loan for farmers and agricultural project owners to cover operational costs and enhance their projects, available in different categories based on the loan amount and repayment period.

product.name: قرض السكوتر (Scooter Loan)
product.description: A loan for purchasing scooters, aimed at customers interested in using scooters for delivery services or personal use.
